_readme: tcv.com/all-companies read 2026-09-29: TCV's marketing-rule list, 'All investments, listed alphabetically', as of 7.15.26. Declared exclusion (the page's own note): 'Does not include investments that were made solely in IPOs or open market public securities in TCV I-III as they represent a different strategy than currently employed.' The same note defines deal types: 'majority' = TCV, singly or together with a consortium of other investors, owns or controls 50% or greater after the closing; 'minority' = less than 50%. legal_name is the page's text verbatim; name is the brand derived by scratch/pull-site-tcv.py (dba wins, fka kept as an alias, legal suffixes dropped).
